title: The L^▷ state-locality fragment (OpenStateLocal.lean)
description: Build FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenStateLocal.lean, the L^▷ counterpart of FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/PlusStateLocal.lean: the syntactic predicate OpenFormula.StateLocal and the semantic IsOpenStateLocal, the soundness induction isOpenStateLocal_of_stateLocal, the fragment-level openStateLocal_openValid_iff_stab, and the agreement biconditional stateLocal_ofPlus_iff saying the L^▷ fragment is exactly the ofPlus-preimage of the L-plus one -- the same shape FormalSystem/Semantics/StateLocalTransfer.lean already uses for L-plus-over-L-star. Then the two negative rows that make the fragment's boundary honest: the restricted-future and restricted-past modals are not state-local, each derivable in a line from the landed ofut_pastDet and opast_futDet. This is the decidability front's one working anchor for the stability modal (one bit per cell) and task 876's own description names its loss as a live risk, so this task is also 876's missing evidence. No reduction vehicle is named because this is a direct build, not a transfer-by-theorem; task 856 phase 12 (soundness) landed during this task's own research/implement cycle, so the only conditional gating this proposal's own description once carried (a derivability row needing soundness) is now satisfied.

title: The L^▷ semantics-support lemmas (per-class validity abbreviations, reflection rows, fresh-atom congruence, recurrence-free biconditional)
description: Collect the small L-plus semantics-layer support lemmas that have no L^▷ sibling and that each take a few lines, as direct transcriptions of their L-plus twins over OpenTruthAt/OpenValidIn with the two new modal cases added to the recursion: the three per-class validity abbreviations OpenValidDense/OpenValidZTime/OpenValidRTime in FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenValidity.lean; the three frame-class-level reflection rows openValidOnFrames_reflectTime, openValidIn_reflectTime, openValidIn_reflectTime_iff that FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenReversal.lean currently stops short of; openTruthAt_congr_of_fresh (the fresh-atom congruence) in FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenTruth.lean; and openValidIn_iff_recurrenceFree in FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenValidity.lean. Optionally absorb, as a final phase, a short FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenIntTransfer.lean stating openTruthAt_map and an OpenValidInt carrier normalization at ZTime -- not purely mechanical like the rest, since it needs either (V3) openValidIn_ztime_iff_tr composed with plusValidZTime_iff_plusValidInt (conditional on SeparationOver TaskFrame.IsZTime) or a direct induction; the ofPlus image alone is reducible unconditionally at every class via (V1) openValidIn_ofPlus_iff. Shares FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/ and FormalSystem/Semantics/ territory with task 869 (open modal invariance ray agreement lifting, file_scope includes FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenInvariance.lean and FormalSystem/OpenLanguage.lean) -- must be batched with it or given an explicit sequencing edge, never dispatched concurrently.

title: L^▷ axiom-set non-redundancy for the 18 new schemata
description: OpenAxiom has 71 constructors against PlusAxiom's 53, and plusAxiomSetNonRedundant (FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/PastingIndependence.lean) has no L^▷ analogue, so nothing currently rules out that some of the 18 new schemata (the eight S5 schemata for the restricted future/past modals, the three ordering schemata stab_of_box/ofut_of_stab/opast_of_stab, hn_open and hn_open_mirror, the four rigidity schemata, and definability_fwd) are derivable from the rest. Scope: state and prove non-redundancy for this block, reusing PastingIndependence.lean's method (a model refuting the candidate while validating the rest) and the landed sinkFrame/NF countermodels, several of which already refute exactly the needed converses (not_openValid_stab_of_ofut, not_openValid_opast_of_ofut, not_openValid_ofut_of_opast). Hard gate: must run after task 856 phase 12 (soundness), since each non-derivability argument needs soundness of the remaining set -- phase 12 landed (committed) during this ledger task's own research/implement cycle, so this gate is now satisfied; task 856's own declared file_scope already includes FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/OpenAxioms.lean, so this proposal should be sequenced after task 856 closes entirely (phase 15, in progress) rather than run concurrently against the same file. A redundancy finding, if any, is a recommendation to the maintainer and never a license to remove a constructor -- the standing ruling against mutating the axiom inductives applies here exactly as it does to PlusAxiom.

title: Name the direct L-to-L^▷ embedding
description: Add a named map OpenLanguage.ofFormula : Formula -> OpenFormula in FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/Formula.lean (the same file that already carries the ofPlus embedding, ofPlus_injective, ofPlus_reflectTime and their rfl commutation pins), equivalently a named abbreviation for ofPlus (PlusLanguage.ofFormula ·), with ofFormula_injective, ofFormula_reflectTime, the context map and its membership lemma, and the rfl commutation pin ofFormula = ofPlus (PlusLanguage.ofFormula ·) that makes every L-plus-level fact about PlusLanguage.ofFormula available at L^▷ by rewriting. Then the single-map readings of the proof embedding of TM into TM^▷ (currently REDUCIBLE at every frame class only via (V2) openDerivable_of_plusDerivable composed with plusDerivable_of_derivable) and the semantic conservativity of L^▷ over L (currently REDUCIBLE by composing (V1) openValidIn_ofPlus_iff with plusValidIn_ofFormula_iff), each one line from the composite. This is the end state's front-door map between the two languages the repository intends to present. Tree-state note: task 856 phase 13 landed FormalSystem/Metalogic/Conservativity/Open/Forward.lean during this ledger task's own audit (commit e3392ff51), using the bare, unnamed pointwise composite ofPlus (ofFormula φ) eleven times under open FormalSystem.OpenLanguage; the 'before task 856 phase 13' ordering this proposal once carried is now moot (phase 13 already landed without the name), but this strengthens rather than weakens the case for this proposal -- the unnamed composite now has concrete, committed consumers depending on it being spelled out at every call site, and landing the name lets Forward.lean's own call sites be rewritten as a follow-up. This proposal shares FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/Formula.lean territory with task 874 (open language substitution closure, file_scope includes FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/Formula.lean and already anticipates needing 'whatever direct embedding Formula -> OpenFormula this file needs') and with task 873 (open language subformula closure, file_scope also includes FormalSystem/OpenLanguage/Formula.lean, for a DecidableEq derivation) -- must be sequenced before both 874 and 873, or batched with whichever lands first, to avoid three uncoordinated edits to the same file.

title: Specialize ofut_not_plusDefinable_of_deltaProp_inexpressible once task 860 lands its bridge lemma
description: Once task 860 (colourclock history bridge lemma, status researched, file_scope FormalSystem/Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean only) lands the compiled 'every colour function is a history' bridge lemma for colourClock, specialize FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/OpenFutureUndefinable.lean's ofut_not_plusDefinable_of_deltaProp_inexpressible to a one-hypothesis form at the witness frame colourFibre D (an instance of colourClock), discharging hmarkers by application rather than leaving it a stated hypothesis -- colourFibre and its regularity instance colourFibre_isRegular are already landed in the same file. Outcome: the theorem's remaining hypothesis is hinexpr alone, the single, clearly-labelled paper step the report names as blocked on open mathematics rather than unwritten Lean. This is a hard, real dependency-ordering gate on task 860 (divide reason (c)): task 860's own declared file_scope is disjoint from this proposal's (TranslationProduct.lean vs. OpenFutureUndefinable.lean), so the two do not collide on the same file, but this proposal cannot start before task 860 closes. Size: trivial once gated open. Do not file this ahead of task 860; it is not independent research, it is the consuming application of 860's own deliverable.
